page.overview:
What is Guanyin Hall?

The is a Buddhist monastery dedicated to Guanyin.

The Guanyin Hall is a pagoda in the mountains. It has over seventy suites and two hundred monks, dhutas, young novices, and Daoists. The courtyard is filled with clouds of red mist and contains bamboo, pine, juniper, and cypress growing.

It is located about twenty miles north of Black Wind Mountain.

When Tang Sanzang and Sun Wukong came to the Guanyin Hall, the jealous monks plotted to set his suite on fire so they could steal his precious cassock. Sun Wukong protected Sanzang with a Fire-Repelling Cover, then made the entire monastery burn down.
